<a id="script_down_back"></a>
### [`script_down_back`](../../../../src/fighter/anim_scripts.asm#L89) `$7842-$785D`

*data*

Animation $08: move 8 (joystick down-back), a somersault back in an arc. 7 steps of 4 bytes: delay, frame, dx, dy. dx counts in each frame of a step, so the steps move the fighter 40 units back in all. Frames $19, $17, $16, $20, $15, $14. Version I had two more steps that moved the fighter 11 units back and then forward, because its frames $16, $17 and $20 were one column to the right.

- **Entry of:** [`anim_script_ptrs`](../../tables.md#anim_script_ptrs)

<a id="script_up_back"></a>
### [`script_up_back`](../../../../src/fighter/anim_scripts.asm#L98) `$785E-$787D`

*data*

Animation $09: move 9 (joystick up-back), a somersault forward in an arc. 8 steps of 4 bytes: delay, frame, dx, dy. dx counts in each frame of a step, so the steps move the fighter 40 units forward in all. Frames $19, $14, $15, $20, $16, $17. Version I moved the fighter 11 units back at frame $20 and 11 units forward at the end, because its frames $16, $17 and $20 were one column to the right.

- **Entry of:** [`anim_script_ptrs`](../../tables.md#anim_script_ptrs)
